content: {"findings":[{"file":"index.js","line":208,"severity":"major","message":"The regex for stripping 'www.' was changed from {1,63} to {2,64} for the middle label length. This breaks stripping for valid hostnames with single-character labels (e.g., 'www.a.com') and incorrectly allows labels up to 64 characters (exceeding the 63-char RFC limit documented in the comment). The comment states 'Each label should be max 63 at length (min: 1)' but the regex now enforces min: 2, max: 64."}]}
